_comment: Seasonal progression, hoarding prep checklists, seasonal mechanic nodes (S1-S5), and hero star pivot costs for Last Z: Survival Shooter.

seasons.name: Season 1: Outbreak
seasons.subtitle: Server Genesis & Capitol Conquest
seasons.summary: The foundational server season. Alliances race to capture tier-1 through tier-6 cities, culminating in the first Capitol Clash and the unlocking of Season 1 Exclusive Heroes.

hoardingChecklist.reason: Push HQ 20-24 early to unlock higher march capacity and T7/T8 troops before City Lv.4 opens.
Farm highest-tier Infected & Radar missions on Day 1 to rush Virus Resistance levels.
Immediately bring your primary S1 carry (Nyx, Selena, or Sakura) to 3-star on VS Heroes Day.
Complete Alliance Recognition multiplier nodes early so every VS day yields double chests.
Required for Saturday Kill Event (Combat Day) and initial Capitol border skirmishes.

mechanicNodes.name: Vaccine Synthesis Lab
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +3,000 Virus Resistance & +15% Passive Mutant Sample Production

mechanicNodes.name: Quarantine Outpost
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +25% Troop Attack & Defense against Season 1 Doom Walkers

mechanicNodes.name: Serum Refinery
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +10% March Size during City Capture and Capitol Siege

metaShift.metaSummary: Wings of Dawn (Shooter) leads early S1 thanks to Nyx + Scarlett + Laura synergy, while Blood Rose players build around Selena and Oliveira for strong frontline sustain.
metaShift.counterTip: Guard of Order (Sakura + Evelyn Riders) hard-counters early Wings of Dawn Shooter stacks in Canyon Clash.

seasons.name: Season 2: Frozen Wasteland
seasons.subtitle: Polar Expedition & Thermal Warfare
seasons.summary: A brutal sub-zero map transition where bases freeze without Thermal Cores. Introduces S+ hero Alma and shifts server warfare to cross-server Polar Citadels.

hoardingChecklist.reason: Season 2 introduces Alma (S+ Shooter) and Bella/Harleyna. 350 fragments unlocks immediate 4-star power spikes.
First 72 hours of S2 require heavy Polar Beast hunting to upgrade Thermal Furnaces before the first Blizzard wave.
Cross-server Polar Citadel battles cause massive hospital overflow; healing speed-ups decide territory control.
Save for S2 Week 1 Vehicle Day to push Tank Modification milestones and unlock seasonal score tiers.
Frequent relocation across Frozen Zones as Thermal Towers expand toward the center.

mechanicNodes.name: Personal Thermal Furnace
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +4,500 Cold Resistance & prevents troop march speed penalty during Blizzards

mechanicNodes.name: Sub-Zero Coal Extractor
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +22,000 Titanium Coal/day passive output & +15% Resource Gathering Speed

mechanicNodes.name: Cryo-Alloy Armory
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +18% All Troop HP and +12% Siege Damage in Polar Citadel battles

metaShift.metaSummary: Alma elevates Wings of Dawn to S+ status with massive backline AoE burst, while Bella gives Blood Rose a premier bruiser and Harleyna stabilizes Guard of Order.
metaShift.counterTip: Invest in Harleyna + Sakura Rider formations to snipe Alma backlines before her second active skill cycle.

seasons.name: Season 3: Biotech Lab
seasons.subtitle: Genetic Mutation & Cybernetic Ascension
seasons.summary: Season 3 introduces the Biotech Lab progression tree and three meta-warping S+ heroes: Dodomeki, Licia, and Liliana. Biotech nodes permanently boost seasonal combat stats and reward T10 badge chests.

hoardingChecklist.reason: HQ 30 gates open around S3; hoard badges for the T10 Research prerequisite chain and Wednesday VS bursts.
Dodomeki (Rider), Licia (Assaulter), and Liliana (Shooter) are all S+ tier. 620 fragments takes one hero straight to 4.5-star.
Maxing Active + Passive skills on S3 S+ heroes to Lv. 20+ provides a 35% combat efficiency jump.
Biotech Lab requires Bio-Helix Cells dropped exclusively from S3 Bio-Mutant Rallies and Radar anomalies.
Keep resources in unopened chests so they cannot be plundered while pushing HQ 28–31.

mechanicNodes.name: Cellular Overclocking Branch
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +25% Troop Attack, +15% Skill Crit Rate in Seasonal Map Zones

mechanicNodes.name: Neural Symbiosis Matrix
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +20% Hospital Capacity, -15% Troop Healing Cost, & unlocks S3 Mythic Gene Core

mechanicNodes.name: Apex Mutation Protocol
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +10% Counter Damage Factor & +15,000 March Capacity in Cross-Server Wars

metaShift.metaSummary: All three factions receive S+ anchors: Licia transforms Blood Rose into a sustain powerhouse, Dodomeki gives Riders lethal backline execution, and Liliana pairs with Alma for dual-S+ Shooters.
metaShift.counterTip: Licia + Bella + Selena (Blood Rose Assaulters) melts Dodomeki Rider squads while surviving Liliana burst.

seasons.name: Season 4: Primal Dinosaurs
seasons.subtitle: Jurassic Hollow & Dino Hatchery
seasons.theme: Dinosaur Taming, Fossil Excavation & Apex Predators
seasons.summary: Commanders enter the Hollow Earth where prehistoric apex predators roam. Tame and evolve combat Dinosaurs while unlocking the current peak S+ trio: Yu Chan, Queenie, and Amber.

hoardingChecklist.reason: 975 fragments maxes an S4 apex carry (Yu Chan, Queenie, or Amber) to 5-Star on Week 1 Heroes Day.
S4 heroes gain Crimson Dominion / Crimson Tide exclusive skills (+10-12% faction ATK & counter mitigation).
Finish Phase 3 & Phase 4 of T10 Troop Research (totaling 1.48M badges) to compete in S4 Apex brackets.
Required for Apex Tyrant Rallies and Amber Fossil excavation nodes during Week 1-2.
Reforge main march Weapon and Boots to Mythic tier before S4 cross-server Canyon Clash.

mechanicNodes.name: Velociraptor Strike Pack
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +22% March Speed & +18% First-Strike Skill Damage in PvP

mechanicNodes.name: Ankylosaur Iron Bastion
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +25% Garrison Defense & -12% Incoming Crit Damage during City Sieges

mechanicNodes.name: Tyrannosaur Alpha Awakening
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: Unlocks Apex Roar active battle skill (+30% All Troop ATK for 10s)

metaShift.metaSummary: Yu Chan + Licia defines the S4 endgame Assaulter meta with +15% Assaulter ATK and +12% Faction ATK, while Queenie + Liliana + Alma creates the highest burst Shooter lineup in the game.
metaShift.counterTip: Amber's Crimson Dominion (+10% vs Assaulters, -10% damage taken from Riders) makes Guard of Order and Wings of Dawn hybrids viable counters to pure Blood Rose stacks.

seasons.name: Season 5: Night Falls
seasons.subtitle: Eternal Eclipse & Shadow Citadel
seasons.theme: Light Beacon Network, Shadow Corrosion & HQ 35 Endgame
seasons.summary: A total solar eclipse blankets the warzone in darkness. Alliances must construct Luminance Beacons to push back Shadow Corrosion, defend against Nocturnal Hordes, and battle for the Shadow Throne.

hoardingChecklist.reason: Guarantees an instant 5-Star S5 Eclipse Hero on Day 4 VS Heroes Day.
HQ 31-35 upgrades and T10 troop replacements consume massive Zent and Steel reserves.
HQ 33-35 build timers exceed 25-40 days per building before buffs.
Required to push Destroyer EX and Vanguard late-tier vehicle modifications.
Shadow Stalker elites only spawn during Eclipse windows and drop 2x Solar Shards.

mechanicNodes.name: Tactical Beacon Spire
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: Illuminates surrounding 5x5 tiles & grants +28% Troop Attack inside Beacon radius

mechanicNodes.name: Eclipse Aegis Protocol
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +30% All Troop Defense & -15% Dead-to-Wounded conversion in Shadow Throne PvP

mechanicNodes.name: Solar Flare Overdrive
mechanicNodes.buffDescription: +20% Exclusive Weapon Skill Damage & +25,000 Rally Capacity

metaShift.metaSummary: Season 5 rewards full 5-S+ multi-march rosters. Players pivot remaining A+/S filler heroes out of their 1st and 2nd marches to form pure S+ Faction Trios (Yu Chan/Licia/Bella, Queenie/Liliana/Alma, Amber/Dodomeki/Harleyna).
metaShift.counterTip: Inside Luminance Beacon zones, Exclusive Weapon skill damage scales +20% — prioritize Exclusive Lv.20 on your primary backline carry.
